items.subject: Axelrod Mechanism A — day-end common knowledge broadcast (both NBA + Political TF)
items.scope: Implemented in scripts/arena/hf-llm-trading-floor/app.py and scripts/arena/hf-political-trading-floor/app.py. DO NOT push to HF Space — committed to mon-ipad only.
items.commit_message: feat(tf): Axelrod mechanism A — day-end common knowledge broadcast (both NBA+Political)
items.notes: Added build_common_knowledge_block() to both apps. After each day-bucket resolves, all agent bets + leaderboard published as COMMON_KNOWLEDGE[D] prepended to day D+1 prompts. DMAD anti-groupthink: day_strategy must start with CONSENSUS AGREE/DIVERGE. _common_knowledge dict persists in module scope + last_ck_block in saved state for resume support.

items.subject: Axelrod Mechanism B — sacrificial role reallocation (bottom-3 archetype swap)
items.scope: Patch both NBA + Political TF apps. At end of each day compute trailing-7d bankroll delta rank. Bottom 3 agents: replace system_prompt with SACRIFICIAL_PROMPT[D] instructing an archetype from the never-used pool. Track USED_ARCHETYPES per day. Pareto-optimal for society (diversity > individual EV). Archetypes list in PLAN.md mission spec.
items.commit_message: feat(tf): Axelrod mechanism B — sacrificial role reallocation (bottom-3 archetype swap)
items.notes: Strategy archetypes: pure_momentum, mean_reversion, news_event_driven, home_underdog_specialist, road_favorite_fade, closing_line_value_only, injury_arbitrage, pace_inefficiency, rest_differential, back_to_back_fade, revenge_narrative, divisional_hate, national_tv_effect, pythagorean_divergence, shot_chart_mismatch, ref_bias_per_team, sharps_follow, sharps_fade, steam_chase, reverse_line_movement

items.subject: Axelrod Mechanism C — end-of-game post-mortem log (paper dataset)
items.scope: Patch both NBA + Political TF apps. Each day-end writes data/arena/axelrod-log/day-N.jsonl with per-agent {decisions, rank, archetype_assigned, was_sacrificed, peer_consensus_distance (KL divergence from CK)}. This is the primary dataset for the paper.
items.commit_message: feat(tf): Axelrod mechanism C — end-of-day post-mortem log + paper dataset schema
items.notes: day-N.jsonl schema: {day_idx, date, agents: [{trader_id, rank, archetype_assigned, was_sacrificed, decisions: [...], peer_consensus_distance: float}]}. KL divergence computed from bet distribution vs consensus distribution across available categories.

on_brain_wake: For each item where status=pending and owner contains 'local-agent-' — ASSUME the local CLI crashed if the local commit hasn't appeared in git log within 6h of updated_at.
Pick lowest-priority pending item; do the scope; commit (do_not_push=true means don't push).
Update this file: set status=done + commit_hash + completed_at OR status=blocked + reason.
on_cli_resume: Re-dispatches status=pending items whose local-agent hasn't committed in 30 min.
